assertions: Five original fields retain independent inactive state, original setters and typed Any selectors.
Writer consumers use actual native spacing state; browser snapshot adapters preserve full fields without a core compatibility facade.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task155 replaces the reduced mode/value/font-independent item with original five-field SvxLineSpacingItem state, native rule enums, default/copy/setter/Clone/equality/hash and typed Any contracts. Actual LineSpacing two-short struct uses shared CPPU metadata and ordinary JS scalar cells, not binary persistence or lifetime machinery. Writer height200 defaults, commands, layout and ODF consume actual fields; browser persistence stores all five fields and decodes old scalar/tuple inputs only at its existing I/O boundary. Font-independent line spacing belongs to Drawing text-object properties and is removed from Writer paragraph model/filter/dialog; generic shared XML support remains. Native inactive-field equality versus all-field hashing and unknown-member successful normalization are preserved and documented. Translated presentation, tab-stop canonicalization, real full engine/pool/Calc model/connected UI and same-model ODS remain pending. Existing semantic statuses and deliberate I/O/recovery deviations remain unchanged.
